title: Detailed lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boltGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3a0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9a1f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='edgeGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8720c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow halo -->
  <polygon points='60,4 26,54 44,54 32,96 76,40 56,40 68,4' fill='#7a4a00' opacity='0.55'/>
  <polygon points='59,8 29,54 45,54 34,90 72,42 55,42 66,8' fill='#b57300' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- main bolt body -->
  <polygon points='58,10 30,53 46,53 36,88 71,43 54,43 64,10'
           fill='url(#boltGrad)' stroke='url(#edgeGrad)' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- bright inner core highlight -->
  <polygon points='57,14 34,52 47,52 39,80 66,45 52,45 60,14' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- hot tip shine -->
  <polygon points='58,10 60,28 52,20' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- secondary branch zigzag on right -->
  <polygon points='62,32 74,40 66,44 78,52 70,55 80,63 71,63 76,70'
           fill='none' stroke='#ffd93b' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='72' r='1.4' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='76' r='1.2' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#ffd93b'/>
</svg>
